main_text.p: non spectasse honorem, præcellentiam, & dignita-tem civilem, sed tantum objectum & finem, ab una parte spiritualem, & vitam æternam spectantem, ab altera Rerumpub. & politi-tię temporalis conservatio-nem, nihilque hoc præju-dicare dignitati Magistra-tuum, quandoquidem illa est αὐτοκρατορικὴ[?], cum alia sit tantum Ministerialis, quod pluribus exemplis illustra-vi, idem paucis, sed verè expressum fuisse à D. Ve-delio, per distinctionem

page.notes: The Greek word after "est" (αὐτοκρατορικὴ) is uncertain in its accents and letters; it is marked [?]. The catchword "eorum" is set at the right below the last line and is therefore given in bottom_margin, not in the text. The word "politię" is split across a line end as "poli-" / "tię"; the ę is printed as a special form and is copied as ę.
